# P107 owner/consumer repair

Core #934: 93d9dc32941ea9c0dac7ad7e1b14a55c6f56c1c3; paired Toad #760 6f3d167cecba9c58182333657949f859e17092a1 (production-identical to bc31b9ed1; approved +23 budget trailer only). No Toad test edits or executions in this takeover.

Compared with inherited af6f09098: source +25/-49 = -24. Whole branch against main96cc6874e: src +992/-472 = +520 (was +544). The remaining feature budget is requested, not assumed approved.

## Seven-file growth review

- goals.py: main has Goal, GoalRevision and mention records, but no structured progress/report/delivery or commanded author. Extend those existing records rather than retain a separate progress module. Deleted Delivery.summary (only forwarded evidence) and require_completion (reported_sha already refuses unfinished delivery). Removed the open_orders loop: GoalAuthor invokes Thread's existing goal-slot owner. GoalProgress.present/NoGoalProgress.present remain the single show/hide decision used by all Toad progress views.
- tools.py: main has ordinary Goal tools but no problem create/assign/transfer/complete/list/fleet declarations. The added requests use the existing ToolRequest registry and FieldCodec; no second tool catalog or handwritten CLI implementation exists. Kept these externally distinct operations. No production duplicate deleted here.
- goal_actions.py: main has the transition/set/clear algorithms. Added order constraints run through those same actions; acceptance preparation must run before the existing write lock, then compare the exact original Goal. No second order transition engine exists. Kept the preparation state because it binds the accepted timestamp to the checked revision rather than rerunning an external acceptance under a lock.
- todos.py: main's Todo/assignment CAS is the existing problem owner; the replacement removes scalar assignee/birth/generation mirrors and keeps a GoalRef on AssignedTodoAssignment. Deleted AcceptedCommit (unused SHA plus a duplicate timestamp carrier); AcceptanceCheck now returns the existing RecordedEventTime directly. Deleted the second unfinished-delivery check. CommandedGoalAuthor no longer iterates a zero-or-one Thread.open_orders collection.
- goal_management.py: main already owns registry Goal publication. writing/write_goal now share that publication and after-unlock notification path across user transitions and automatic failure/recovery, rather than duplicate registry writes at each action. No second goal store or retained notification-result store was added. Kept this shared implementation.
- goal_states.py: main is the existing lifecycle owner. Replaced open_orders tuple construction with require_replacement behavior on GoalState/UnfinishedGoal. Deleted unconsumed require_send_back hooks. Terminal/open replacement policy stays with this state family, not a consumer's terminal flag or one-element loop.
- recorded_time.py: main already has EventTime/RecordedEventTime/UnrecordedEventTime. Reuse that family for deadline and accepted Git commit time. No separate Deadline/NoDeadline family or new timestamp store remains. before/after/deadline validation are consumed by Goal lateness and state notification behavior; kept the shared timestamp behavior.

Thread.require_goal_replacement is the one optional-slot check; GoalState owns open/terminal behavior, and GoalAuthor/CommandedGoalAuthor own ordinary/commanded replacement policy. Deleted Thread.open_orders entirely. Repository search for open_orders, AcceptedCommit, require_send_back and delivery.require_completion now has zero src/tests hits.

## Source evidence and checks

- Before AST: Core src/tests/tools, actual paired Toad checkout and metaclass_registry; 1067 modules, no parse omissions. .artifacts/p107-takeover-before-ast.txt. Syntax evidence does not prove arbitrary dynamic dispatch/MRO resolution.
- Final exact Core head: 21 focused Goal/Todo/report-preservation/block-reason checks passed in14.58s. .artifacts/p107-takeover-final-head-checks.log.
- Final exact-head debt ratchet against main96cc6874e: exit0, no positive deltas or introduced violations. .artifacts/p107-takeover-ratchet-checked.json.
- Earlier long AST/ratchet attempts reached their tool bounds and produced no full result; not claimed passing.
- Codex private paired build delivered. Actual installed Toad/ACP/native owner on own Xvfb :6 in plain st opened an SDK fork of this agent's real saved session. Revision2 hid the progress row; canonical backend updates to revision3 text and revision4 structured report appeared in the same open UI. Personally viewed all three screenshots while the application was alive. No Toad tests, fake app or provider turn. Result: /home/ts/.cache/agent-scratch/rts-results/P107/ui.json.
- Screenshots: /home/ts/.cache/agent-scratch/gr107/ui/none-visible.png; text-visible.png; report-visible.png.
- Initial private launch errors are preserved separately, not relabeled: the frontend login environment first selected default workers, then isolated native discovery could not find the configured model. Final launch uses an explicit private HOME in the ACP command and original native configuration discovery; all processes are the paired candidate. A manual preparation initially collided on reused parent creation identity after creating the native fork; that fork was retained and registered with a fresh child identity, not forked again.
- Private installed UI accepted at this scope. No default publication or retained-goal/schema carry acceptance. The remaining +520 Core feature budget is proposed for review, not self-approved.
